definitions.explanation: A large, warty, slow-moving frog that lives mostly on land, such as the Japanese common toad. ヒキガエル is the standard zoological name; in everyday speech the same animal is often called ガマ or ガマガエル.

examples.japanese: ⟦{庭|にわ}→庭：02239_niwa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ヒキガエルがいた。
examples.english: There was a toad in the garden.

examples.japanese: ヒキガエル⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{夜|よる}→夜：00487_yoru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{虫|むし}→虫：02262_mushi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。

⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{夜|よる}→夜：00487_yoru⟧、⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧ヒキガエル⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦のそのそ→のそのそ：05942_nosonoso⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{横切|よこぎ}って→横切る：02326_yokogiru⟧いった。
examples.english: On a rainy night, a big toad lumbered slowly across the road.

notes:
Usually written in katakana; the kanji spelling is {蟇蛙|ひきがえる}. The skin gives off a mildly poisonous fluid, so dogs and cats that bite toads can get sick.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ガマ→ガマ：28705_gama⟧ / ガマガエル: toad — the everyday name for the same animal
- ⟦カエル→カエル：28199_kaeru⟧: frog (general word)
